decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the second V's derivation from Option 2, inheritance of the right-arm termination, and all three adjustment constraints.
The existing message-114 MODIFY fully records the decisive terminal conclusion, prohibited adjustments, shared application, expression goal, and expanded contexts.

The existing message-114 MODIFY captures the Option 2 selection and preservation of the Hero V's established geometry; the terminal-specific refinement is independently owned by the signature-terminal Requirement.
The terminal refinement does not change the deferred wordmark's composition rhythm, kerning, or visual hierarchy.
The source changes shared terminal geometry, not the deferred champagne material treatment, its qualities, or its application sequence.
Quiet confidence and becoming are used to evaluate the terminal against already established brand expression; the source does not establish a new or changed brand-expression rule.
The source explicitly affects the Hero V, second V, and É accent, not the deferred internal wordmark letterforms or L construction.
Refining a shared terminal does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
